metas.name: 1. Monty Burns' Fleeing Circus
metas.description: When a fire levels Springfield, Mr. Burns agrees to the Simpsons' pleas that he fund the town's rebuilding, on the condition that he gets to put on a variety show.

metas.name: 2. Friends and Family
metas.description: Mr. Burns hires the Simpsons, except Homer, to be his virtual family; Homer becomes best friends with the girl next door.

metas.name: 3. The Town
metas.description: After Homer catches Bart rooting for Springfield’s football rival, the Boston Americans, he plans a family “hate-cation” trip to Boston in an attempt to show Bart that Boston is a terrible city.

metas.name: 4. Treehouse of Horror XXVII
metas.description: Better late than never, The Hunger Games come to Springfield!

metas.name: 5. Trust But Clarify
metas.description: Lisa and Bart investigate Krusty’s suspicious new "Krustaceans" candy. Meanwhile, Homer wants a promotion at the nuclear plant and asks Marge to help him dress the part, and news anchor Kent Brockman struggles to find his feet in the changing media world.

metas.name: 6. There Will Be Buds
metas.description: Homer gets roped into coaching the kids' lacrosse team with Milhouse's dad, Kirk, who is in desperate need of a friend. When Kirk gets too clingy, Homer vents about how much of a loser he is. Kirk overhears his rant and disappears, right when the team needs him most: the champion

metas.name: 7. Havana Wild Weekend
metas.description: When the Retirement Castle and the V.A. Hospital can’t solve Grampa’s health issues, the Simpsons decide to take a family trip to Cuba to get him cheap medical care.

metas.name: 8. Dad Behavior
metas.description: Homer finds a new app that makes his life much easier and outsources his father-son bonding. Meanwhile, Grampa finds that he is about to be a father again.

metas.name: 9. The Last Traction Hero
metas.description: A workplace accident leaves Homer in a cast, and in a position to sue Mr. Burns. This leaves Marge unfulfilled, so she turns to an unexpected source for romance. Meanwhile, Lisa is made "Bus Monitor" and tries to keep the peace.

metas.name: 10. The Nightmare After Krustmas
metas.description: Krusty tries to impress his daughter as they spend Christmas with the Simpsons. Meanwhile, Reverend Lovejoy seeks converts after church attendance plummets, and Maggie is haunted by a spooky Christmas toy.

metas.name: 11. Pork and Burns
metas.description: When Marge becomes obsessed with a Japanese style of living, the Simpsons must part with any item that no longer brings them joy. For Homer, this means finding a new home for the family pig. For Lisa, it means saying goodbye to her beloved sax

metas.name: 12. The Great Phatsby (1)
metas.description: Mr. Burns tries to relive his glory days and crosses paths with a mysterious music mogul. After being conned by him and reduced to bankruptcy, Mr. Burns seeks revenge on the Music Producer with the help of Homer, Bart, rapper Jazzy James and the mogul's ex-wife, Praline. Also, Li

metas.name: 14. Fatzcarraldo
metas.description: All of the fast food restaurants in Springfield go healthy, forcing Homer to turn to the last bastion of greasy food for comfort.

metas.name: 15. The Cad and the Hat
metas.description: Bart deals with his guilt after betraying Lisa; Springfield is in awe of Homer when he is revealed to be a chess savant.

metas.name: 16. Kamp Krustier
metas.description: Bart and Lisa return home from Kamp Krustier early, interrupting Homer and Marge's romantic encounters; Bart and Lisa confront a source of trauma.

metas.name: 17. 22 for 30
metas.description: Bart goes from delinquent with detention to the star basketball player at Springfield Elementary. Lisa covers Bart’s success for the school paper, and Homer becomes the team’s coach. Things go awry when Bart gets involved with the mafia

metas.name: 18. A Father's Watch
metas.description: Marge turns to a series of parenting experts for advice when she becomes worried that Bart is destined for failure; Homer decides to open a trophy store; Grampa gives Bart a watch coveted by Homer.

metas.name: 19. The Caper Chase
metas.description: Disappointed in Yale, Mr. Burns decides to start his own for-profit university and Homer is hired as a professor

metas.name: 20. Looking for Mr. Goodbart
metas.description: Bart gets in trouble on Grandparents Day at school and is forced to hang out with Skinner's mother as punishment. metas.name: 21. Moho House
metas.description: Mr. Burns makes a bet with his old friend that nothing can break Homer and Marge apart. But that's where Moe comes in.

metas.name: 22. Dogtown
metas.description: After a successful animal rights campaign, all dogs in Springfield are allowed to go where they want and do what they want. Pack mentality quickly kicks in and the dogs of Springfield assert their dominance by threatening the people.
